_comment: Offline rows shaped like finance.payment_buffer. Totals follow ledger_bucket (income, expense, investment). verified_income is a side metric only, not the income total. Served when FINANCES_FIXTURE or VITE_FINANCES_FIXTURE is set, or when no RPC client is configured. A configured RPC that fails returns 503 and does not use these rows. Rhoda cash-outs are rental income, not expenses: direction outbound, ledger_bucket income, category rental_income, claim_status ignored. Airtel money from Rhoda is rental_income, not subscription_payment. TID 10900844301 amount 3000 matches live. occurred_at in this file is the offline shape. Pending inbound TIDs exist so unverified inbounds can be tested. No phone numbers. No raw_sms. Investments are intentionally absent. Do not invent a second ledger. Do not seed payment_verifications.

entries._comment: Rhoda cash-out. ledger_bucket income, category rental_income, direction outbound, claim_status ignored. Amount 3000 matches live. Not an expense.
